messages:
nora_sre: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — capturing remediation items we agreed on for GPU surge-proofing and autoscale/quota. I'll own the tracker. Short bullets + owners. Ping if anything looks off.

ashley_platform: Thanks — I can take scheduler tuning + staggered pod warmup tests. Will run baseline on staging tomorrow.

devon_scheduler: I'll own the quota bump proposal for Dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Draft PR by Friday.

maria_capacity: I will validate headroom calc and run sim with the new traffic traces. Plan to share results by Thu.

ben_oncall: Oncall will add a lightweight runbook snippet for emergency manual scaling (kubectl commands + check list).

nora_sre: Owner / due list (we agreed):
- scheduler tuning — @ashley_platform — due 2024-07-12
- quota bump proposal — @devon_scheduler — due 2024-07-14
- headroom sim + numbers — @maria_capacity — due 2024-07-11
- ops runbook snippet — @ben_oncall — due 2024-07-09
I'll create the follow-up tasks in INF board now.

infra-bot: Created task INF-4521: "Scheduler tuning & staggered warmup" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-07-12

ashley_platform: Plan sketch: increase autoscaler target to 0.75, add a small pre-warm buffer of 2 GPUs, and bump scaleDownDelay to 90s. Testing on staging now. Snippet:
```
autoscaler:
  targetUtilization: 0.75
  preWarmGPUs: 2
  scaleDownDelaySeconds: 90
```

devon_scheduler: For quota ask: propose +10 GPUs in eu-west-1 dedicated pool, staged as +5 immediate, +5 in 3 weeks. Opening infra PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/767

maria_capacity: Quick sim notes: using recent 99th pct traces peak shows ~8 GPUs required for tail. With 25% headroom recommendation -> add 2 GPUs. Uploading perf report: https://internal/reports/headroom-july.csv

ben_oncall: Runbook snippet added to ops-runbooks repo. Manual scale example and checklist:
```
# emergency manual scale
kubectl scale deploy inference --replicas=10 -n redwood
# check pod readiness, wait for KV cache warmup, notify traffic-router
```
Alert playbook also updated to include "quota-approach" step.

nora_sre: Two follow-ups: 1) can we do a canary rollout for scheduler changes? 2) devops/finance coordination for quota request approvals. @ashley_platform @devon_scheduler

ashley_platform: :thumbsup: Canary plan: rollout to 10% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours with health checks at each step. I'll post the rollout schedule in #eng-runtime and link the canary job.

devon_scheduler: Will loop in finance. FYI quota bump needs approvals from Jake and Priya. I'll include estimated monthly spend in the PR.

maria_capacity: I can run a final sim with the proposed scheduler config and share before canary. No objections from me.

ben_oncall: Noted. Added a recurring monthly headroom run and scheduled an automated report job so we catch regressions early.

nora_sre: Thanks all. I'll leave these open until tasks are created. Last operational note from the postmortem: the recurring incident pattern correlates with scheduled batch job bursts around 03:00 UTC. Suggest we either throttle those jobs or shift them out of peak windows.

ashley_platform: Agree — I'll add job windowing as part of the scheduler ticket.

devon_scheduler: LGTM.

maria_capacity: :wave: I'll deliver the report by Thu as promised.

ben_oncall: :white_check_mark: Runbook committed and monthly job scheduled.
